snippet.title: Axe Me Why World Overview Trailer
snippet.description:
Axe Me Why is a post-apocalyptic horde fighter set in the Spirit Realm of Anfraca. Survive 15-minute runs, harness ancestral powers, and fight evolving waves of enemies.

Step into the Spirit Realm of Anfracka in Axe Me Why — a post-apocalyptic horde fighter where survival, ancestral power, and community are everything.

STEAM: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4081620/Axe_Me_Why/

-Face endless waves of enemies.
-Harness the Baobab’s strength and ancestral guidance.
-Build, grow, and push your limits through 15-minute journeys of survival.

This is just the beginning. Follow along as we prepare to bring an accessible, powerful experience soon.

Stay connected for updates:
Website: https://atrybute.co.za/
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/atrybutegraphics/?hl=en
Discord: https://discord.gg/zArbfxgm
TikTok: https://www.tiktok.com/@atrybute

Steam page coming soon — wishlist support will mean the world when it’s live!

#roguelike #newgame  #survivalgame #postapocalyptic #apocalypse
